messages:
naomi_am: Quick ask ": CircuitHealth (acct CH-204) got hit with a huge usage spike during a one-time ingestion. They were billed INV-2026-4350 and request a $15,500 credit + two-week Dedicated trial extension. Can we approve?

juan_sales: Client says they ran an ETL load overnight; not a regular pattern. They're in POC and signal likely expansion. Recommend credit to keep momentum.

ravi_finance: Anything >$10k needs deal desk approval. Is the invoice posted and what's the billing window?

naomi_am: Invoice posted 2026-05-18 for May 12-17. SRE confirmed spike came from client ETL job; client fixed config after we notified them. Looks one-off.

kelly_revops: We should limit the credit to that invoice and add explicit language that this is a one-time courtesy. Also include retention estimate for approval doc.

juan_sales: Expected ARR if converted: ~$90k. High chance to convert next quarter. Full $15.5k would be ideal.

sara_legal: I'll review amendment language. Need wording to avoid precedent.

ravi_finance: Tentatively approve if legal signs amendment and we cap credit to INV-2026-4350. GL 7302. Please add NetSuite note referencing deal desk approval.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-091 created and awaiting finance routing.

naomi_am: I'll draft amendment: "Redwood will apply a one-time credit of $15,500 to INV-2026-4350 and grant a 14-day Dedicated trial extension. This is a single-instance customer goodwill adjustment and does not change pricing or create precedent."

juan_sales: LGTM. I'll send to the customer once legal signs.

ravi_finance: Final step: legal sign-off then finance will post CM-2026-091. Marking pending until posting complete.

naomi_am: Thanks — will update thread when credit posts.
